description: Use this to see which Faxette account the person signed in with: their name, email, credit, and whether it's the US or EU copy. Needs the person to sign in to Faxette; calling it while they aren't asks the app to sign them in. It changes nothing.
name: get_account

credit.description: The account's credit, which send_fax spends.

email.description: Where Faxette sends receipts and updates for faxes started while signed in.

region.description: Which copy of Faxette the account is on.

title: See who is signed in
